01 — About

Where science
becomes spectacle.

I hold a BSc in Biology and MSc in Genetics — disciplines that trained me to see structure within chaos, pattern within noise. That same precision now drives how I design and operate live visual systems for some of the world's most demanding stages.

The microscope and the mixing console are not so different. Both reveal invisible worlds in real time. My work as a Visual Director is a direct extension of a scientific mind: systematic, rigorous, and always in pursuit of the moment where technology and imagination collide.

Since 2023, I have been the sole visual operator and content producer for arena-scale concerts, electronic music festivals, and live theatrical productions — carrying my own equipment, building content from concept to output, and conducting it live every night.

I am fluent in the full signal chain: from creative brief to LED wall, from generative code to FOH rack, from AI-generated cinematics to real-time camera cuts. Available for international touring, festival residencies, and one-off productions.
